title: Our Ultimate Holiday Gift Guide for New and Expecting Parents
summary: The holiday season is a special time to celebrate the joy of new beginnings, and what better way to do that than by giving thoughtful gifts to new or expecting parents? Whether they're navigating the unpredictable experience of pregnancy or embracing the highs (and lows) of parenthood, here's a curated list of gifts that will pamper and support parents on every step of their journey.
body_markdown:
The holiday season is a special time to celebrate the joy of new beginnings, and there's nothing better than finding gifts that make the lives of parents easier, cozier, and filled with peace of mind. Whether it's their first little one or they're adding to the family, each of these gifts are practical and meaningful, supporting parents on every step of their journey.


# 1.[Owlet Dream Duo 3](https://owletcare.com/products/dream-duo-3?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=DreamDuo3)


[Owlet Dream Duo](https://owletcare.com/products/dream-duo-3?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=DreamDuo3) ™


, which includes the FDA-cleared


[Dream Sock](https://www.owletcare.com/products/owlet-dream-sock?utm_source=Blog&utm_medium=BlogPost&utm_campaign=DreamSock) ®


smart baby monitor and


[Dream Sight](https://owletcare.com/products/dream-sight?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=DreamSight) ™


2K HD video monitor, is Owlet’s most complete monitoring system designed to help parents feel calm, confident, and connected from day one. Dream Sock wraps comfortably around your baby’s foot to track pulse rate, oxygen, and sleep patterns, while Dream Sight delivers a crystal-clear view of your little one. With real-time health notifications, room temperature and humidity monitoring, and seamless integration through the Owlet Dream App, Dream Duo provides clear insights into your baby’s well-being, bringing safer, sounder sleep for the whole family this holiday season. Plus, Dream Sock and Dream Duo are HSA/FSA eligible, making it easier to gift peace of mind.


For parents who already use and love their Owlet products, an[Owlet360](https://owletcare.com/products/owlet360-annual-plan?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=owlet360) ™ membership is the perfect gifting option. Owlet360 offers deeper, more personalized insights, helping families navigate every stage of their baby’s sleep and wellness journey with confidence.


Not sure what to gift? An[Owlet Gift Card](https://owletcare.com/products/gift-card?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=giftcard) is a thoughtful choice that lets new or expecting parents choose the products that best fits their needs, making it a meaningful, flexible gift for any growing family.


# 2.


[Hatch Go](https://www.hatch.co/rest-go)


A restful baby equals a restful parent, and the


[Hatch Go](https://www.hatch.co/rest-go) portable sound machine helps create the perfect sleep environment anytime, anywhere. Clip it on your stroller, place it next to your travel crib, or toss it into your diaper bag when you’re on-the-go. Featuring 10 of your little one’s favorite sounds, it helps soothe your little one to sleep effortlessly. This gift is ideal for parents wanting to set up consistent sleep patterns for their little one from day one.


# 3.


[Kindle Paperwhite](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DFYWDGW6) ****


The


[Kindle Paperwhite](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DFYWDGW6) is a thoughtful gift for new parents looking to unwind with a good book during rare quiet moments. With its paper-like display and weeks-long battery life, it’s perfect for reading anywhere, anytime—whether it's during naptime or on the go. Waterproof and lightweight, the Kindle Paperwhite makes reading accessible and easy, giving parents a little escape in their busy days.


# 4.


[Meal Delivery Gift Card](https://www.doordash.com/gift-cards/) ****


Adjusting to life with a newborn can make mealtimes challenging, so a meal delivery gift card is a lifesaver!


[Blue Apron](https://www.blueapron.com/gifts) offers fresh, ready-to-cook meals that bring restaurant-quality dishes to the home. We love Blue Apron because of the wide variety of meal choices and ease of the recipes (work smarter, not harder).


****


For the days when cooking is too much, a


[DoorDash gift card](https://www.doordash.com/gift-cards/) lets them order from their favorite local spots with just a tap. This is a practical and thoughtful gift that will provide some much-needed ease during those first busy months.


# 5.


[Nespresso Vertuo Pop+](https://www.nespresso.com/us/en/order/machines/vertuo/vertuo-pop-plus-coconut-white)


****


Every new parent needs coffee and Nespresso is a great gifting option. The


[Nespresso Vertuo Pop+](https://www.nespresso.com/us/en/order/machines/vertuo/vertuo-pop-plus-coconut-white) offers a range of coffee styles at the touch of a button—from smooth espressos to full-bodied coffee. With its advanced brewing technology and one-touch simplicity, Nespresso gives new parents the boost they need for those early mornings and late nights. A stylish and practical addition to any kitchen!


# 6.


[Oura Ring](https://ouraring.com/product/rings) ****


At Owlet, we’re big fans of sleep! Sleep doesn’t come easy in the newborn stage, but recovery still matters. The


[Oura Ring](https://ouraring.com/product/rings) helps parents track sleep quality, stress, and overall wellness in one sleek, comfortable design. It provides personalized insights into rest, readiness, and recovery so parents can better understand how their bodies are adjusting during postpartum life. With guided breathing, activity tracking, and an easy-to-read app, Oura empowers parents to prioritize their own health while caring for their little one.


# 7.[Grownsy EaseClean Pro Bottle Washer](https://grownsy.com/products/easeclean-pro-bottle-washer)


Keeping bottles clean has never been easier. The[Grownsy EaseClean Pro](https://grownsy.com/products/easeclean-pro-bottle-washer) washes, steam sterilizes, dries, and stores bottles, pump parts, and feeding accessories in one cycle. With room for up to 8 bottles, 26 spray jets, and a 19-minute quick wash mode, it’s a great pick for new parents who want less time at the sink and more time with their little one.


# 8.


[Theragun Prime](https://www.therabody.com/products/theragun-prime-gen-6-massage-gun) ****


The


[Theragun Prime](https://www.therabody.com/products/theragun-prime-gen-6-massage-gun) by Therabody is a thoughtful gift for parents who could use some quality self-care. It’s a top-of-the-line massager that offers much-needed relief for sore and achy muscles. The quiet motor and customizable speed settings make it ideal for new parents needing a quick moment of relaxation and recovery. It’s perfect for easing the tension that often comes with the demands of parenthood. You can thank us later.


# 9.


[Barefoot Dreams Throw Blanket](https://www.barefootdreams.com/products/copy-of-cozychic-throw-all-colors)


The


[Barefoot Dreams Throw Blanket](https://www.barefootdreams.com/products/copy-of-cozychic-throw-all-colors) is a chic, ultra-soft throw that’s perfect for cozying up on the couch or taking a much-needed nap. Its warmth and softness make it an instant favorite, providing comfort during late-night feeds or family movie time. A great gift for any parent who appreciates the finer (and cozier) things in life.


# 10.


[Artifact Uprising Photo Book](https://www.artifactuprising.com/photo-books/hardcover-books) ****


Help parents preserve every precious moment with a custom photo book from


[Artifact Uprising](https://www.artifactuprising.com/photo-books/hardcover-books) . These beautifully crafted books are perfect for capturing baby’s first milestones and turning them into keepsakes. It's a meaningful gift that lets them document and share memories for years to come.


Each of these gifts is designed to bring convenience, comfort, or a little extra peace to the holiday season. Whether helping parents with health and sleep tracking with[Owlet Dream Duo 3](https://owletcare.com/products/dream-duo-3?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=DreamDuo3) , or simply creating moments of relaxation with the[Barefoot Dreams Throw](https://www.barefootdreams.com/products/copy-of-cozychic-throw-all-colors) , these gifts will support parents who are expecting or have recently welcomed their new bundles.
